name: Keyframe-based Dynamic Volume Stylization
aliases: Dynamic Volume Animation via Keyframing and Blending
definition: A technique for animating stylized volumes by optimizing target appearances at discrete keyframes and linearly blending the resulting volumes to generate intermediate frames.
summary: Keyframe-based Dynamic Volume Stylization animates stylized volumes by optimizing target appearances at discrete keyframes and linearly blending them, using a Laplace regularizer to prevent artifacts in zero-extinction regions.
